shortBio.en: Queen bassist from 1971; writer of bass-led hits including Another One Bites the Dust.
shortBio.zh: 1971 年起 Queen 贝斯手；写作 Another One Bites the Dust 等贝斯驱动热单。

body.en:
Joined 1971, completing the classic four. Melodic bass and funk-leaning grooves on late-70s singles. Retired from public Queen performance after the mid-1990s.

Absence marks the end of classic-IV continuity more cleanly than any guest singer hire.
body.zh:
1971 年加入，凑齐经典四人。70 年代末单曲上的旋律贝斯与偏 funk 律动。1990 年代中期后退出公开 Queen 演出。

他的缺席比任何客座主唱更能干净标出经典四人连续性的结束。

note.en: Studio/live classic four; later withdrawal from touring.
note.zh: 录音室/现场经典四人；后期退出巡演。
